title: Bad Boy MZ Rambler 42" Zero-Turn Riding Mower 26 HP Kohler Engine
description:
The Bad Boy MZ Rambler Zero-Turn Lawn Mower is built for homeowners who demand professional-level performance, durability, and efficiency. Engineered with rugged construction and precision control, it delivers powerful cutting performance while maintaining smooth and responsive handling around obstacles and tight spaces.
Powered by a 26 HP twin-cylinder Kohler engine, this zero-turn mower provides strong, reliable performance for demanding residential mowing applications. The dual Hydro-Gear ZT2200 transmission system ensures smooth acceleration, precise steering, and effortless zero-turn maneuverability for faster and more efficient mowing.
Built with a heavy-duty all-steel welded frame and a reinforced fabricated 42-inch cutting deck, the MZ Rambler is designed for long-term durability and consistent cutting performance. The robust deck construction ensures clean, even results across various lawn conditions while resisting wear over time.
Operator comfort is enhanced with an ergonomic seat design and user-friendly controls, making extended mowing sessions more comfortable and less fatiguing. The foot-assisted deck lift system with dial adjustment allows quick and accurate cutting height changes, improving overall efficiency during operation.
Additional features such as electric blade engagement and maintenance-friendly spindle design simplify operation and reduce upkeep requirements, making this mower both powerful and practical for residential use.
Key Specifications:
Brand: Bad Boy
Model: MZ Rambler
Product Type: Zero-Turn Riding Lawn Mower
Engine: 26 HP Kohler Twin-Cylinder
Cutting Width: 42 inches (1066 mm)
Transmission: Dual Hydro-Gear ZT2200
Frame: Heavy-Duty Welded Steel (50×50 mm)
Deck Type: 7-Gauge Fabricated Steel Deck
Cutting Height Range: 38 mm – 114 mm
Fuel Capacity: 22.73 L
Maximum Speed: Up to 9.66 km/h
Drive Type: Zero-Turn
Deck Lift: Foot-Assisted with Dial Adjustment
Blade Engagement: Electric PTO
Tires: Rear 18×8.5-8 Turf / Front 11×4-5
Weight: 287 kg
Recommended Use: Residential Lawn Care / Medium to Large Yards
